text.config.mageflame.title: Mage Flame Configuration
tooltip.mageflame.bubble_flame.desc: Allows the spellcaster to conjure a Bubble Flame.
tooltip.mageflame.bubble_flame.lore: A bright flame within its own air bubble.~Able to travel underwater.
tooltip.mageflame.ember_hound.desc: Allows the spellcaster to summon an Ember Hound.
tooltip.mageflame.ember_hound.lore: The spellcaster is able reach into the nether~plane and summon an Ember Hound.~Ember Hounds have a long lifespan.
tooltip.mageflame.glowglob.desc: Allows the spellcaster to create a glowglob.
tooltip.mageflame.glowglob.lore: A weak stationary source of light.
tooltip.mageflame.greater_revelation.des: The most powerful of the magical flames.
tooltip.mageflame.greater_revelation.lor: The spellcaster is able to channel a great~amount of power to generate a large ball~of magic-blue fire. Brighter than a torch~and has staying power.
tooltip.mageflame.lesser_revelation.desc: A more powerful version of Mage Flame.
tooltip.mageflame.lesser_revelation.lore: A ball of magic-green fire. It has a more~powerful light and increased lifespan than Mage Flame.
tooltip.mageflame.mage_flame.desc: Allows the spellcaster to create a small ball of flames.
tooltip.mageflame.mage_flame.lore: The weakest of the summoned flames,~well-suited for the apprentice spellcaster.~It will allow you to see, but not as bright~as a regular torch.
tooltip.mageflame.winged_torch.desc: Allows the spellcaster to summon a Winged Torch.
tooltip.mageflame.winged_torch.lore: The spellcaster is able reach into the astral~plane and summon a Winged Torch. The torch~will remain under your charge until you~release it or it perishes.
